As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

  • A global organization that acquires and scales vertical market software companies delivering mission-critical solutions in specialized industries.


  • The company focuses on long-term growth, operational excellence, and customer success, providing acquired businesses with a permanent home where they can continue to thrive.


  • Operating with an active mergers and acquisitions strategy, the organization creates a fast-paced environment where finance and operations teams play a crucial role in integrating new businesses and driving scalable processes.


About the role

  • The Lead Finance Systems (Oracle NetSuite) Specialist is responsible for leading end-to-end ERP integration projects for newly acquired companies.


  • This role focuses on migrating legacy financial systems into a centralized Oracle NetSuite environment and ensuring alignment with standardized financial processes.


  • You will oversee discovery, configuration, migration, and post-go-live support with minimal oversight.


  • Working closely with finance leadership and operational teams, you will ensure data integrity, compliance, and successful adoption of the new systems.


  • This is a leadership role requiring both technical ERP expertise and strong project management skills.


Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end migration projects for newly acquired companies, including legacy ERP data migration and system configuration.


  • Conduct discovery sessions to understand current-state processes and design future-state configurations within Oracle NetSuite and connected tools.


  • Create and manage project plans, timelines, risks, and deliverables, ensuring on-time and high-quality execution.


  • Coordinate the migration of chart of accounts, vendors, customers, transactions, and ledger balances from legacy ERPs into NetSuite.


  • Lead configuration and deployment of core modules within NetSuite (e.g., GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Bank Recs, etc.).


  • Standardize financial processes across acquired entities to align with group policies and reporting standards.


  • Collaborate with accounting and finance teams to ensure business readiness for go-live and support month-end close activities post-migration.

title: Coordenadora administrativa-financeira pleno
description:
Vaga exclusiva para mulheres (cis e trans). Candidaturas devem ser enviadas para , contendo carta de apresentação, + currículo. Não serão analisadas candidaturas enviadas por outros canais.



A Empodera está à procura de uma pessoa dinâmica, organizada e motivada para coordenar nosso time administrativo-financeiro e trabalhar para o empoderamento e garantia de direitos de meninas e mulheres.

A coordenadora administrativa-financeira pleno é a responsável, juntamente com a gestão executiva, por analisar, gerenciar e implementar sistemas e processos administrativos e financeiros eficientes e transparentes na organização. Ela é responsável pela coordenação e acompanhamento da equipe da área, pela elaboração de orçamentos e relatórios de prestação de contas, controle de fluxo de caixa e conciliação bancária. Além disso, desenvolverá processos integrados, que aumentam a eficiência e a eficácia da organização, em um ambiente empreendedor e colaborativo. 


A Empodera incentiva fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas negras, indígenas, pessoas vivendo com HIV/AIDS, pessoas LGBTI+ e com deficiência.


Quem somos

Fundada em 2017, a Empodera – Transformação Social pelo Esporte é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos com sede no Rio de Janeiro e atuação nacional, que utiliza o esporte e jogos lúdicos como ferramenta para que meninas adolescentes em situação de vulnerabilidade social exerçam seu pleno potencial e direitos. As ações da organização são focadas em promover a redução dos estereótipos nocivos e da violência baseados no gênero. A Empodera trabalha com o desenvolvimento e execução de metodologias esportivas, treinamentos e suporte técnico de organizações em prol de uma sociedade mais justa e equânime.

Principais responsabilidades


FINANCEIRO – OPERAÇÕES  (40%)  

  • Gerenciar o fluxo de caixa organizacional  
  • Supervisionar as operações financeiras diárias – contabilidade, contas a pagar/receber, salários, obrigações fiscais 
  • Analisar e apresentar relatórios financeiros de maneira precisa e oportuna; comunicar claramente as demonstrações financeiras mensais e anuais; elaborar relatórios financeiros para prestação de contas e supervisionar a contabilidade financeira, de projetos/programas e doações  
  • Fornecer informações financeiras, conforme solicitado, e responder a consultas financeiras  
  • Supervisionar e liderar a elaboração do orçamento organizacional anual e planejamento financeiro em conjunto com a diretora executiva; monitorar progresso e mudanças; e manter a equipe de gestão a par do status financeiro da organização  
  • Supervisionar a  conciliação bancária de acordo com o fluxo de pagamento semanal
  • Fornecer atualizações sobre despesas por centro de custo/projeto, bem como outras informações financeiras em tempo hábil e preciso  
  • Priorizar e organizar ações e recursos para alcançar objetivos e contribuir para o desenvolvimento estratégico da Empodera.  
  • Gerenciar e monitorar o input das informações financeiras junto a um sistema integrado da organização 
  • Emitir notas fiscais de acordo com as obrigações legais e fiscais



FINANCEIRO – GESTÃO DE PROGRAMAS (15%)  

  • Manter comunicação frequente com as coordenadoras de projetos para análise dos gastos (reais x orçados)  
  • Apresentar a prestação de contas dos projetos nos prazos estipulados  
  • Fornecer relatórios financeiros mensais às coordenadoras de projetos, incluindo gastos por centro de custo / projeto, de maneira oportuna e precisa  
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de orçamentos para editais  
  • Garantir que a organização atenda aos requisitos externos dos doadores  
  • Comunicação com parceiros para transmitir informações sobre os programas, conforme apropriado.  


 FINANCEIRO – COMPLIANCE (10%)  

  • Atualizar e implementar todas as políticas e procedimentos financeiros necessários  
  • Coordenar e liderar eventuais processos de auditoria   
  • Supervisionar a produção do relatório financeiro anual   
  • Examinar documentos financeiros e legais para verificar a precisão e a aderência aos regulamentos e princípios financeiros aceitáveis  
  • Garantir o uso eficaz e transparente dos recursos financeiros, em conformidade com as políticas e procedimentos da Empodera e organizações parceiras  


ADMINISTRATIVO – (15%)  

  • Coordenar as atividades administrativas da área/equipe 
  • Aprimorar/elaborar processos administrativos e políticas internas
  • Supervisionar os processos administrativos, em conformidade com as políticas e procedimentos adotados pela Empodera  
  • Orientar a equipe em relação aos procedimentos administrativos e financeiros  


RECURSOS HUMANOS E DEMAIS ATIVIDADES (20%)  

  • Coordenar, acompanhar e colaborar para o desenvolvimento da equipe
  • Garantir que folha de pagamento mensal, pagamento de benefícios e manutenção de registros das/os funcionárias/os sejam executados de maneira eficiente   
  • Garantir a conformidade com os regulamentos da legislação trabalhista local  
  • Participação em treinamentos internos e externos sobre temas relacionados à função e aos programas desenvolvidos pela organização. 



FORMAÇÃO, EXPERIÊNCIA E HABILIDADES NECESSÁRIAS  


Formação:  Nível superior completo, com preferência para as áreas de ciências contábeis, administração, economia  


Conhecimentos e experiência:   

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas como Finanças, Controladoria, Gestão Estratégica ou Administração (será um diferencial)
  • Conhecimentos avançados do pacote office (particularmente excel) ou Google Workspace
  • 3 a 5 anos de experiência em rotinas administrativas, financeira, contábeis e de pessoal (fluxo de caixa, contas a pagar e receber, elaboração de orçamento, conciliação bancária)  
  • Experiência comprovada no setor administrativo-financeiro em organizações da sociedade civil ((altamente desejável)   
  • Experiência com coordenação de equipes e de processos
  • Experiência com prestação de contas para agências das Nações Unidas (desejável)  
  • Experiência com elaboração, execução, prestação de contas e auditoria de projetos nacionais e internacionais  
  • Experiência com controles internos e bancários  
  • Experiência com o sistema financeiro Ongsys ou outro sistema de ERP (será um diferencial)


Habilidades:   

  • Comunicação clara e assertiva

  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e em vários projetos simultaneamente  
  • Organização
  • Proatividade 
  • Boa administração de tempo

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Location: Remote (LATAM only)

Contract: Full-time (40h/week)

Compensation: USD $14,000 – $18,000 gross per year (depending on experience)

Languages: Fluent English required, with familiarity in French

Seniority: 3+ years in B2B SaaS Customer Support

Start Date: ASAP


We’re hiring a Customer Support Specialist with strong technical capabilities to help us deliver high-quality, reliable support at scale.


At FullEnrich, support is central to the product experience. Our customers rely on our data for revenue-generating workflows. That means our responses must be accurate, structured, and genuinely helpful, not just fast.


About FullEnrich

FullEnrich helps businesses find accurate emails and phone numbers to reach the right people.


Unlike most enrichment tools that rely on a single source, FullEnrich aggregates 20+ data providers into a waterfall system that automatically tests multiple sources to return the best available contact data.


We are a profitable B2B data platform used by 3,000+ customers, with around 2,000 new signups every week. Our product supports sales, recruiting, marketing, and operations teams worldwide.


We’re a remote-first team of 20+ people across the US, UK, and Europe. We value ownership, clarity, and high standards in how we work.


What You’ll Do

  • Respond to customer questions via Intercom (chat & email) and Slack
  • Troubleshoot product, billing, and account-related issues
  • Help customers troubleshoot API requests, bulk CSV uploads, credit usage questions, and external tool integrations (e.g. HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier)
  • Investigate issues using internal documentation and tools before escalating
  • Manage multiple real-time conversations while maintaining clarity and quality
  • Escalate bugs with clear context and reproducible steps
  • Improve internal documentation when gaps are identified


We value thoughtful problem-solving. Clear explanations matter as much as technical accuracy.


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B SaaS customer support
  • Strong understanding of APIs, external tool integrations, and bulk data uploads (CSV)
  • Comfortable troubleshooting technical issues independently
  • Excellent written English
  • French familiarity required; fluency not necessary
  • Experience with Intercom or similar support tools
  • Structured, calm, and reliable in real-time chat environments
  • Based in LATAM time zones


Why Work at FullEnrich

  • Profitable and growing with strong product-market fit
  • A small team where your work has visible impact
  • Remote-first and internationally distributed
  • A support culture focused on quality, clarity, and accountability


If you take pride in delivering exceptional support and enjoy solving technical problems thoroughly, we’d be happy to hear from you.

description:

Location: LATAM

Role: Partnerships Manager (LATAM)

Department: Sales

Mode: Full-time


About Respond.io

Founded in Hong Kong in early 2017, respond.io is an AI-powered business messaging platform that helps companies manage customer conversations across chat, calls and email — all in one place.


Trusted by businesses in over 127 countries and recognized by G2 and SME100, respond.io enables fast-growing companies around the world to capture, convert, and retain customers at scale.


We operate as a globally distributed team with employees based around the world, contributing to a diverse and inclusive culture. Join us, and be part of a team that is shaping the future of customer conversation management!


Our Culture

At respond.io, we move fast, work smart, and always keep our customers at the heart of what we do. Here’s what we stand for:

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!
  • The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.
  • 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.
  • Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!
  • Own It and Support Each Other: We step up, help out, and drive outcomes—together.
  • Build Human Connections: Work is better when we trust, care, and celebrate wins together. We’re a team!


Role Description

Respond.io is expanding rapidly, aiming for a $1 billion valuation following our successful Series A funding. We seek a visionary Partnerships Manager to nurture and support our channel partner ecosystem. The ideal candidate will drive mutual success through strong relationship management, strategic collaboration, and effective enablement.


Responsibilities

  • Identify potential channel partners that align with the company's strategic goals.
  • Develop and execute recruitment strategies to onboard new partners.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with existing channel partners.
  • Act as the main point of contact for partners, addressing their needs and concerns.
  • Organize regular meetings, business reviews, and performance assessments with partners.
  • Develop and deliver training programs to educate partners on the company's products, services, and sales processes.
  • Provide ongoing support and resources to partners to ensure their success.
  • Collaborate with partners to develop and execute joint business plans to drive sales and market penetration.
  • Monitor and analyze partner performance metrics, providing insights and recommendations for improvement.
  • Achieve sales targets and revenue goals through effective partner management.
  • Gather market insights and feedback from partners to improve product development and strategy.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, competitor activities, and market dynamics.


Qualifications

  • Minimum 3+ years of experience in channel management, partner-led sales and business development experience.
  • Experienced in Channel/Sales in a SaaS based company
  • Proven track record of successfully managing and growing channel partner relationships.
  • Experienced in building business and marketing plans with Partners.
  • Well-organized, proactive, goal-oriented, and able to prioritize.
  • Ability to operate both at a strategic and hands-on level.
  • Fluent in Spanish, English & Portuguese with an ability to clearly explain complex ideas verbally and in writing.
  • Nimble and agile team player with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced start-up environment.


Here's what's in for you

  • You will become part of an amazing culture with smart, collaborative teammates who actually care about each other's growth and success.
  • You will grow more here than you would anywhere else, that is a promise.
  • Virtual events like talent shows, Among Us nights, and online game sessions to keep the fun going, no matter where you are!
  • We offer a highly competitive compensation package.
  • You'll receive a medical allowance to support your health and wellness needs.
  • Flexible working environment and working hours that fit your lifestyle, wherever you're based.

title: Engenheiro(a) de IA (Generative AI & Agentic Systems)
description:

Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


Estamos expandindo nosso time de tecnologia e buscamos profissionais para atuar na fronteira da inteligência artificial aplicada aos setores financeiro e securitário. O foco será a construção de ecossistemas inteligentes, indo além de modelos isolados para criar arquiteturas de agentes capazes de resolver demandas complexas de negócio e backoffice.


O DESAFIO:


  • Orquestração e Agentes: Projetar sistemas multiagentes utilizando LangGraph ou Agent Squad para decompor tarefas complexas em workflows automatizados.
  • Observabilidade e Tracing (Prioridade): Implementar o rastreamento completo da \"cadeia de pensamento\" (Chain of Thought) e execução dos agentes.
  • Monitoramento de Performance: Utilizar ferramentas como Langfuse ou LangSmith para monitorar latência, consumo de tokens e qualidade das respostas em tempo real.
  • Desenvolvimento de Ferramentas: Criar conexões seguras entre LLMs e APIs externas via Model Context Protocol (MCP) , garantindo o isolamento e a segurança dos dados.
  • Arquitetura RAG: Otimizar pipelines de recuperação de informação utilizando Vector Stores (Pinecone ou MongoDB ) para mitigar alucinações e aumentar a precisão contextual.
  • Infraestrutura Cloud: Gerenciar deploys em ambientes AWS ou Azure e integrar modelos via AWS Bedrock ou Azure OpenAI Service , priorizando arquiteturas Serverless e Event-Driven.
  • AI Guardrails: Implementar camadas de filtragem e validação de prompts/outputs para evitar injeções de código ou desvios éticos.
  • Avaliação Sistemática: Desenvolver frameworks de testes (Evals) para validar a eficácia de novas funcionalidades antes do deploy em produção.
  • Eficiência de Custos: Monitorar e otimizar o uso de modelos (Model Routing) para equilibrar performance e custo operacional.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:


  • Linguagens: Domínio avançado de Python e Java para automação de workflows e integraçoes e desenvolvimento de IA.
  • DevOps/MLOps: Experiência com Docker , Containerization e práticas de CI/CD para modelos de linguagem.
  • Educação: Graduação em Engenharia de Computação ou áreas correlatas.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:


  • Experiência prévia na construção de assistentes inteligentes escaláveis (ex: via WhatsApp) e pesquisa em Explainable AI (XAI) .

title: Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

“Estamos buscando um Engenheiro Sênior de Automação de Mainframe experiente para liderar a migração e otimização de soluções de automação em mainframe. Esta função tem como foco a transição do CA OPS/MVS para o IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e do CA Automation Point para o IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) .

O candidato ideal terá um papel crítico para garantir a eficiência operacional, a disponibilidade dos sistemas e processos de automação contínuos em um ambiente z/OS complexo.

Você irá colaborar de perto com a equipe de Automação para implementar soluções de automação baseadas em políticas, reduzir a sobrecarga administrativa e aumentar a capacidade de resposta dos sistemas. Esta posição não impacta o desenvolvimento de aplicações, mas influencia significativamente as estratégias e operações de automação.”


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar projetos de migração de CA OPS/MVS para IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e de CA Automation Point para IBM SAIOM.
  • Configurar e implementar soluções IBM Systems Automation, incluindo automação baseada em políticas para ambientes z/OS.
  • Desenvolver e manter regras de automação, execs REXX e configurações do System Automation Policy Database (PDB) .
  • Prestar suporte na instalação e configuração de produtos de automação da IBM.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de operações para otimizar processos de inicialização, desligamento e recuperação dos sistemas.
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade e eficiência dos sistemas críticos por meio de estratégias proativas de automação.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e etapas de migração, garantindo comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Identificar e resolver problemas relacionados à automação em ambientes de produção.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • Experiência em Operações de Mainframe: Mínimo de 5+ anos em ambiente de operações de mainframe, em funções operacionais, de serviços, consultoria ou suporte.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Conhecimento avançado e experiência prática.
  • CA OPS/MVS: Avançado.
  • TSO e ISPF: Proficiência no uso dessas ferramentas para gerenciamento de sistemas.
  • JCL: Fortes habilidades em Job Control Language.
  • Programação REXX: Capacidade de escrever e manter scripts REXX.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Conhecimento prático obrigatório.
  • Experiência em Migração: Histórico comprovado em projetos de migração de automação em z/OS.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experiência na implementação e utilização deste produto.
  • Scripting REXX: Avançado.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • Conhecimento de outros softwares IBM Z, incluindo operação, configuração e automação de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com processos de inicialização e desligamento do sistema z/OS.
  • Experiência com SMP/E para instalação e manutenção de software.
  • Entendimento de produtos de automação concorrentes no ecossistema de mainframe.
  • Especialização em configurações de sistemas totalmente automatizados em IBM Z.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Company: Fraud Deflect


Role: Data Analyst


Language: Native/fluent English. Resumes in English.


About the role

Help Fraud Deflect turn data into clear, reliable insights across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, and operational performance. The focus is working within the current stack to improve reporting, analysis, data quality, and decision-making, not rebuilding everything from scratch.


Responsibilities

  • Own reporting and analysis for core business datasets.

  • Comfortable working with existing systems and improving them incrementally.

  • Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, or risk data.

Send an English resume and links to APIs/code/docs showing Python, Clickhouse, SQL, automation, and payments/chargebacks work.

title: \"Arquiteto de Cloud #996719\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

• Desenho de soluções: Elaborar diagramas e arquiteturas em nuvem garantindo alta disponibilidade, resiliência e SLA mínimo de 99,9%.

• Migração para cloud: Liderar estratégias de lift and shift, replatform ou refactoring de ambientes on-premise para Google Cloud.

• Governança: Definir e implementar padrões de nomenclatura, estrutura de tags, controle de acessos e políticas de segurança para todo o ambiente.

• Otimização de custos (FinOps): Realizar análises recorrentes de consumo, identificando oportunidades de redução de custos e eliminação de desperdícios.


Experiência :

• Domínio dos core services do Google Cloud: Experiência avançada com Compute Engine, GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine), Cloud Run e VPC Networking.

• Dados & Analytics: Vivência com BigQuery, Pub/Sub e Dataflow em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e altamente escaláveis.

• Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Forte atuação com Terraform (preferencialmente) ou Google Cloud Deployment Manager.

• Segurança & IAM: Implementação de políticas de least privilege, gestão de identidades (Cloud Identity) e utilização de Shared VPC.

• FinOps: Capacidade de monitorar, analisar e otimizar custos utilizando Google Cloud Billing e Recommender.

• Mentoria técnica: Atuação no desenvolvimento e evolução técnica de engenheiros e desenvolvedores.

• Experiência com ambientes multicloud ou híbridos, utilizando Anthos.

title: Senior Front End Engineer
description:
Senior Front End Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

For one of our clients, a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Senior Front End Engineer.


Role Overview


We are seeking a Senior Front End Engineer to lead custom front-end development for a

Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud implementation. This role will be the first dedicated front-end

engineer on the project and is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy,

technical ownership, and architectural judgment.

This is not a theme-tweaking role. You will design, build, and evolve a modern headless

front end integrated with Sitecore DXP and OrderCloud APIs.


Key Responsibilities


• Design and implement a custom headless front end for Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud

using modern JavaScript frameworks.

• Build production-grade applications using Next.js, with deployment targets such as

Vercel or Netlify.

• Integrate front-end applications with:

-OrderCloud APIs

-Sitecore DXP APIs

-Authentication, catalog, search, pricing, and checkout services

• Translate UX/UI designs into scalable, accessible, and performant front-end

implementations.

• Establish front-end architecture patterns, conventions, and best practices suitable

for a growing team.

• Collaborate closely with UX, product, and backend teams to ensure clean API

contracts and realistic implementation.

• Optimize performance, SEO, and Core Web Vitals for commerce use cases.

• Participate in technical decision-making around tooling, frameworks, and

deployment strategy.

• Own front-end code quality, testing approach, and release readiness.


Required Qualifications


• 5+ years of professional front-end development experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with Next.js and React in production environments.

• Experience building headless or composable front ends for CMS or commerce

platforms.

• Solid understanding of modern front-end architecture:

-SSR, SSG, ISR

-Client vs server components

-State management patterns


• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Experience integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs.

• Familiarity with modern deployment platforms such as Vercel or Netlify.

• Familiarity with design systems and component-driven development.

• Comfortable working as an initial solo contributor while setting foundations for

future scale.


Preferred Experience


• Proactive use of AI-assisted code generation tools (e.g., Cursor + Claude) to:

-Accelerate development, refactoring, and prototyping.

-Design and implement automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) for

modern front-end applications.

-Leverage Figma MCP to translate Figma designs directly into production-

ready component code, reducing design-to-implementation cycle time.

• Hands-on experience with headless CMS/commerce platforms.

• Experience working on B2B or complex eCommerce applications.

• Ability to read, understand, and modify code in adjacent front‑end frameworks such

as AngularJS or similar React‑like ecosystems.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.



Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
SOBRE A LETS


A LETS é uma empresa de tecnologia que atua na integração de canais de venda com operadores logísticos, potencializando resultados de negócios por meio de soluções inovadoras. Nosso sistema SaaS, chamado Max, é a espinha dorsal que conecta varejistas, operadores logísticos e canais de venda de forma eficiente e automatizada, oferecendo uma experiência simplificada e eficaz para todos os envolvidos. Nossa missão é desenvolver soluções tecnológicas inovadoras que maximizem o desempenho e a eficiência dos negócios, capacitando empresas a alcançar resultados excepcionais.


Estamos crescendo rapidamente e buscamos talentos que queiram fazer parte de nossa jornada, ajudando a transformar o ecossistema de tecnologia e logística. Se você é uma pessoa apaixonada por dados, focada em desenvolvimento de produto e, apaixonada por criar soluções eficientes e escaláveis, queremos conhecer você!


ATIVIDADES:

  • Construir pipelines de ingestão e transformação de dados usando Kestra, DBT, Python e Athena;
  • Modelar e manter dados em Apache Iceberg com controle de versionamento, time travel e performance analítica;
  • Integrar fontes diversas (bancos, APIs, arquivos, etc.) com foco em rastreabilidade e escalabilidade;
  • Criar e manter modelos transformacionais com DBT, preparando datasets confiáveis e auditáveis;
  • Participar de integrações de dados com fluxos de IA/MCP, colaborando com cientistas e analistas;
  • Desenvolver dashboards com QuickSight, Metabase (ou ferramentas similares) com foco em usabilidade e performance;
  • Atuar em decisões de arquitetura, boas práticas de dados e melhoria contínua dos pipelines;
  • Contribuir para a construção de uma base de conhecimento, registrando soluções frequentes e otimizações para o uso futuro;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com outras áreas, como produto e operações, para garantir que feedbacks dos clientes sejam levados em consideração.


REQUISITOS:

  • Experiência com AWS Athena e estruturas de dados em S3;
  • Domínio de Apache Iceberg ou formatos semelhantes (Delta Lake, Hudi);
  • Vivência com ferramentas de orquestração como Kestra (ou equivalentes como Airflow, Prefect);
  • Conhecimento prático em DBT e versionamento de modelos analíticos;
  • Forte domínio de Python para automações, integrações e manipulação de dados;
  • Noções de Inteligência Artificial e Modelos Cognitivos de Processamento (MCP);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI como QuickSight, Metabase ou similares de nível compatível.
  • Conhecimentos aprofundados em SQL;
  • Conhecimentos em ferramentas de IA e desenvolvimento de prompts adaptáveis;


HABILIDADES DESEJÁVEIS:

  • Ensino Superior em Curso nas áreas de Engenharia, Ciências da Computação/Dados, Estatística ou correlatas;
  • Experiência anterior com produtos de tecnologia ou SaaS com ênfase em dados e BI;
  • Experiência prévia com de BI;
  • Conhecimento básico de sistemas logísticos ou de e-commerce será um diferencial.


BENEFÍCIOS:

  • Remuneração competitiva + participação nos resultados .
  • Plano de saúde (incluindo cônjuge e filhos).
  • Licença Remunerada Anual
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternindade

  • Seguro de vida .
  • Cartão de benefícios flexível .
  • Day Off de Aniversário.
  • Rotina com ferramentas modernas e IA ; aprendizado contínuo.
  • 100% remoto (trabalhe de qualquer lugar do Brasil).


DETALHES:

  • Modelo de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) .

  • Local: remoto – fuso BRT (GMT-3) .

COMO SE DESTACAR:

Ao se candidatar, envie portfólio, GitHub, dashboards ou cases (mesmo acadêmicos/pessoais) que mostrem, na prática:

  • Construção de pipelines de dados de ponta a ponta (ingestão, transformação, modelagem e consumo).

description:

title: Pessoa Estagiária em Inteligência de Negócios
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Apoiar a construção de especificação dos projetos na área como programas de engajamento, construção de ferramentas, atualização e melhorias nos processos existentes
  • Atuar de forma pró-ativa com as demais áreas (Jurídico, CSC, Régua de Cobrança, Faturamento, TI, Contas a Receber, Fornecedores e etc)
  • Apoiar na construção e atualização de Calendários, rotinas e rituais da área

title: Back-End Developer (.Net / C#)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Back-End Developer with 5+ years of experience and strong expertise in .NET and C#. This role focuses on ingesting and transforming data from multiple sources, running data validations, and ensuring high data quality across ETL pipelines and backend services. The ideal candidate has experience with APIs, legacy data migrations, and AWS-based data environments. Experience with ECS Fargate, SQS, Kinesis, Firehose, S3, and Apache Iceberg is a plus.

This project has a 3-6 month duration with a possibility for long-term engagement.

Our client is a leading energy technology company focused on digitizing fuel operations through a single, real-time platform. Their software connects people, equipment, and facilities to provide enterprise-wide visibility and data-driven insights that fuel asset optimization, improve operational efficiency, and help organizations manage risk, maintenance, and fuel logistics more effectively.

Responsibilities


  • Receive and process raw data from multiple internal and legacy systems.
  • Design and implement data transformation pipelines that convert incoming data into standardized formats.
  • Develop and maintain .NET / C# services and APIs used for data ingestion and transformation.
  • Build and execute data validation and quality checks to ensure the reliability and accuracy of data pipelines.
  • Support ETL processes, including exporting data from legacy systems and integrating it into modern platforms.
  • Work closely with existing engineers responsible for data migration and integration efforts.
  • Act as a data quality advocate, focusing on validating and testing data flows rather than application UI or front-end functionality.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipeline performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering and data teams to improve data consistency, validation processes, and pipeline stability.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering or data engineering roles.
  • Strong experience with .NET and C# development.
  • Experience developing APIs and backend services.
  • Hands-on experience with data pipelines, ETL processes, and data transformation.
  • Experience implementing data validation and data quality checks.
  • Experience integrating data from multiple systems or legacy platforms.
  • Familiarity with AWS-based data infrastructure and services.


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Python for data processing or scripting.
  • Experience working with Apache Iceberg tables for data lake management.
  • Experience with AWS data and streaming services, such as:
  • Amazon ECS Fargate
  • Amazon SQS
  • Amazon Kinesis
  • Amazon Kinesis Firehose
  • Amazon S3


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:

Sobre a vaga

Estamos buscando um Desenvolvedor React Native que não apenas construa interfaces, mas que entenda como integrar Inteligência Artificial no core do produto. O candidato ideal é um engenheiro \"AI-First\", que utiliza ferramentas como Cursor para acelerar o desenvolvimento e possui conhecimento profundo sobre como orquestrar Agentes de IA e gerenciar contexto via MCP (Model Context Protocol).

Você trabalhará diretamente com Spec-Driven Development (SDD), transformando PRDs (Product Requirement Documents) em especificações técnicas precisas que alimentam fluxos de codificação assistida por IA.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento Mobile: Arquitetar e desenvolver aplicações escaláveis em React Native (iOS/Android) com TypeScript.
  • Integração de IA: Implementar funcionalidades que consomem LLMs, gerenciam estado de conversação e integram ferramentas externas via MCP.
  • Fluxo AI-First: Utilizar o editor Cursor como IDE principal, dominando a composição de contextos, regras de projeto (.cursorrules) e automação de refatoração.
  • Engenharia de Especificação: Atuar no modelo Spec-Driven Development (SDD). Ler o PRD, criar/refinar a Spec técnica e garantir que a implementação siga estritamente o contrato definido, utilizando IA para geração e validação de código.
  • Agentes Autônomos: Desenvolver ou integrar \"Agent Skills\" dentro do app, permitindo que o usuário interaja com agentes capazes de executar tarefas complexas (ex: buscar dados, agendar, analisar).
  • Qualidade: Garantir performance, acessibilidade e testes automatizados, validando o código gerado por IA.


Requisitos

  • React Native: Domínio avançado (Hooks, Performance, Native Modules, Reanimated).
  • TypeScript: Tipagem estrita e avançada.
  • Ecossistema de IA: Experiência prática com Cursor IDE (Composer, Chat, Rules).
  • Conhecimento de MCP (Model Context Protocol) para conexão de dados e ferramentas.
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de AI Agents e Orquestração (LangChain, Vercel AI SDK ou similar).
  • Metodologia: Vivência com Spec-Driven Development ou trabalho orientado a contratos de interface/API.
  • Produto: Capacidade de ler e questionar PRDs, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em especificações técnicas.

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

title: Product Designer
description:
SigmaMD aims to make a meaningful contribution to the world by changing the way people manage their health. Our growing engineering and product team has deep expertise in consumer tech. We are combining our diverse backgrounds to innovate in Digital Health.


Our goal is to make millions of lives healthier by using technology. We strive to empower patients to take control of their health care and help clinicians better treat them. To achieve this vision we need an outstanding and passionate Product Designer to take on the following responsibilities:


  • Contribute to high-level product thinking while also developing interaction flows, mockups, and prototypes. 
  • Collaborate in a cross-functional team to understand user needs and business goals, and translate them into intuitive and effective product designs.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to communicate design concepts and gather feedback.
  • Advocate for the needs and preferences of both doctors and patients by conducting user research and gathering feedback from both groups, and incorporating their insights into the design process to ensure the product meets the needs of all stakeholders.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, design best practices, and the latest design tools and technologies to ensure the team is delivering high-quality, cutting-edge products.


This person should share our core values of teamwork, empathy, and innovation. Ideally, they have the following:


  • Know how to define a repeatable and shareable design process that encourages collaboration between design, product, and engineering teams.
  • Ask questions that build or help to clarify the problem statement and ensure that you maintain user focus and empathy.
  • Explore and refine concepts, then narrow to the best solution, weighing technical feasibility and scope with your team.
  • Create and maintain UX and UI deliverables including information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, style guides, micro interaction specifications, and pattern libraries.
  • Influence the product vision leading and participating in research, focused on both the intangibles (emotional needs) and tangibles (functional needs)..
  • Champion usability testing within your product team, capture the team's assumptions, identify the correct test methodology to use, document results, communicate actionable feedback and findings back to the team.
  • Communicate your design rationale to project stakeholders and use data to defend your design choices.


Required Skills

  • 2+ years of product design experience (including equivalent UI and UX focused role).
  • Able to provide samples of work that show creative solutions to complex products, strong visual design, and information architecture.
  • A strong understanding of the entire product development process, from research and problem solving through to detailed UI and visual design.
  • Experience with Figma.
  • Understand how modern technologies are used with design.
  • Believe that product and design decisions are inextricably linked.
  • Enjoy shipping small, quick experiments to explore and validate your ideas.
  • Know how to balance the user experience with technical and business requirements.
  • Able to communicate effectively with all stakeholders. Speak KPIs, OKRs and understand how to rely on data to support your work.
  • Not afraid to learn new things to take on a problem.
  • Are a self-starter who works proactively to solve problems and bring clarity to ambiguity
  • Facilitate both design-focused and cross-functional sessions with ease, relying on your knowledge of facilitation tools and techniques


Desired Skills

  • Have an understanding of front end technologies such as HTML and CSS.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Prior experience in a design related role at a startup.
  • Experience with digital health or relatable areas.
  • Experience working with mobile apps.

description:

USA Timezone

Contractor / PJ position



Role Overview

The goal is to shape the reliability and scalability of mission-critical platforms on Azure, Kubernetes , and modern DevOps toolchains. You will solve complex infrastructure challenges, automate end-to-end operations, and ensure systems operate with high availability, performance, and security.


What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and improve CI/CD pipelines for applications and infrastructure
  • Develop automation frameworks that reduce manual effort and increase consistency.
  • Configure and optimize cloud infrastructure to align with security, scalability, and performance best practices.
  • Collaborate with development teams to remove deployment blockers and improve delivery workflows.

  • Maintain technical documentation for pipelines, configurations, and runbooks.
  • Perform readiness assessments and validation tests before production rollouts.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and ARM templates with version control and reproducibility.
  • Troubleshoot complex deployment, provisioning, and performance issues across multi-cloud and containerized environments.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven track record in SRE or DevOps roles operating production systems
  • Hands-on experience running production workloads on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, including cluster design, autoscaling, upgrades, and network policies.
  • Proven CI/CD delivery using GitHub Actions or Jenkins , including promotion across environments, approvals, and rollback strategies.
  • Infrastructure as Code expertise with Terraform and ARM templates, including modules, remote state, workspaces, and policy enforcement.
  • Strong scripting in PowerShell, Bash, or Python for automation and diagnostics.
  • GitOps experience with Argo CD or Flux , managing multi-environment application delivery and drift remediation.
  • Containerization with Docker and Kubernetes , including health probes, PodDisruptionBudgets, resource quotas, HorizontalPodAutoscaler, and operators.
  • Networking fundamentals with cloud network security practices such as VNet design, NSGs, Private Link, and ingress controllers.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security and compliance, including least privilege, secrets management, audit trails, and control evidence.
  • Excellent written and spoken English .

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Azure certification , such as Developer Associate, Administrator, or DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Observability using Application Insights, Elastic Stack (ELK), Grafana, and Prometheus for metrics, logs, and traces.

  • Understanding of high availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization strategies.
  • Experience managing Windows-based containerized applications .


Plus

  • Experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS

title: Video Editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, Social content and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Senior Supply Chain Analyst
description:
The Senior Supply Chain Analyst will be responsible for managing procurement activities, supplier performance, contracts, and materials flow to support operational demands. The role requires close interaction with operations, engineering, logistics, finance, and external suppliers, ensuring timely delivery, cost optimization, and compliance with internal and external requirements.


The successful candidate will be based in the Rio de Janeiro area.


**Please submit Resumes/CVs in English.


Duties


  • Manage procurement processes from requisition to delivery, including RFQs, negotiations, purchase orders, and follow-up
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with local and international suppliers
  • Analyze costs, lead times, and supply risks to support sourcing decisions
  • Support contract management, including commercial terms, service levels, and compliance
  • Coordinate logistics, importation, and exportation processes when applicable
  • Monitor supplier performance and propose continuous improvement actions
  • Support inventory control, critical materials analysis, and stock optimization
  • Prepare reports, KPIs, and dashboards to support management decision-making
  • Ensure compliance with internal procedures, HSE requirements, and applicable regulations


Required


  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Logistics, or related field
  • Advanced English skills (written and spoken)
  • Strong experience in procurement and supply chain operations, preferably in industrial, offshore, oil & gas, or logistics environments
  • Microsoft Office proficiency, including Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, and SharePoint
  • Strong analytical, negotiation, and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
  • Experience with ERP systems is a plus (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics Business Central, SAP, Oracle)

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
About Us :



Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In



You'll be a key player within the Sportingtech Team and joining a group of highly skilled professionals, with a pivotal responsibility in creating performing and scalable Java-based solutions across our award-winning iGaming Platform.



Who are You ?



As a Senior Java developer you'll become a part of our multinational Scrum teams to create state-of-the-art software solutions. In all teams we cooperate with internal and external experts from different knowledge domains to discover and build the best solutions possible.


Technologies Used:



Java 8+, Spring Boot, RabbitMQ, Kafka, JDBC, NoSQL, Relational Databases, PostgreSQL, AWS, Dynatrace



The Impact you will have:



  • Software Development: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, architects, and other stakeholders to design, develop, test, and deploy robust Java applications
  • Code Quality: Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while following best practices and coding standards. Also guide less senior engineers towards Test driven development.
  • Technical Analysis: Analyze and troubleshoot complex technical issues, providing innovative solutions and improvements.
  • Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation to aid in code understanding and future enhancements.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with team members, including architects, developers, and QA’s, to deliver high-quality software in a timely fashion. Also mentor in different areas less experienced engineers.
  • Performance Optimization: Identify and implement performance enhancements, scalability improvements, and code optimizations.
  • Technology Stack: Stay up to date with the latest Java-related technologies and frameworks to recommend and implement the best solutions.
  • Code Reviews: Collaborate with the Team Lead to drive and standarise code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to standards.
  • Security: Implement security best practices and contribute to maintaining the security of applications.
  • Agile Development: Embrace agile development methodologies, such as Scrum or Kanban, to facilitate project delivery.



What we’re looking for:




  • Strong experience with JDBC, JDBI or ORM tools
  • Practical experience and a strong grasp of Java concurrency
  • Development of distributed systems
  • High level proficiency and skills in at least one of the following technologies: AMQP, ZeroMQ, JMS, Kafka
  • Strong experience with MVC frameworks
  • Knowledge of Spring and Spring Boot
  • Proficient in SQL
  • Understanding of principles of the Clean Architecture
  • Proficiency in backend development, including Rest API practice
  • Proficiency in principles of the Clean Architecture
  • Expert in creating automated unit and integration tests
  • Proficiency of multi-thread applications, OOP & MVC concepts and design patterns
  • Proficiency with Git or other version control systems.




Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

title: Gerente - Barra Shopping - RJ

title: Gerente de Obras Civis (Experiência em Projetos Industriais)
description:
Estamos em busca de um/a Gerente de Obras Civis, que será responsável pela execução civil de projetos petroquímicos, controlando interfaces, assegurando conformidade técnica, integridade estrutural, execução sequenciada e aderência a requisitos de segurança de processo. Este/a profissional atuará em uma de nossas obras na região do Rio de Janeiro/RJ, tendo estas atribuições principais:


  • Alinhar bases civis, estruturas, pipe-racks, utilidades e áreas de processo conforme sequenciamento eletromecânico e de instrumentação do projeto;
  • Conduzir reuniões técnicas multidisciplinares (Civil, Mecânica, Tubulação, E&I, Automação, SMS) para garantir a compatibilização de projetos e a antecipação de interferências críticas durante a execução das obras;
  • Validar soluções de projeto civil com foco nas necessidades específicas da planta, como cargas dinâmicas de equipamentos rotativos, vibração, fundações especiais para tanques e suportação de tubulações;
  • Controlar interfaces com montagens industriais, garantindo que as estruturas civis, bases e alinhamentos estejam liberados dentro do prazo para instalação de equipamentos críticos;
  • Gerenciar o desenvolvimento e atualização do ‘’As Built” civil sincronizado com alterações de campo, revisões de engenharia e modificações industriais (MOCs);
  • Acompanhar e validar ensaios e controles tecnológicos essenciais para áreas industriais, como ensaio de compactação, ensaios de integridade estrutural, controle de concretagem para bases de equipamentos e pavimentos industriais;
  • Integrar a obra civil aos requisitos de segurança de processo, garantindo atendimento a normas, zoneamentos, distanciamentos, contenções, bacias e drenagem industrial;
  • Gerenciar a interface com fornecedores e contratados, alinhando soluções técnicas e cronogramas para minimizar impactos entre civil, montagem eletromecânica e comissionamento;
  • Atuar em parceria com a área de Suprimentos, dimensionando corretamente a compra de materiais, prezando por custo e boa gestão de estoques;
  • Manter relacionamento produtivo e transparente com entidades sindicais e órgãos fiscalizadores, conhecendo a legislação trabalhista e convenção coletiva, preservando a segurança empresarial.


Perfil Requerido:

  • Formação Superior completa em Engenharia Civil;
  • Pós-Graduação e/ou MBA em Gerenciamento de Projetos, Gestão da Construção Civil, Segurança de Processos Industriais ou Gestão de Riscos;
  • Sólida experiência em obras do ramo industrial (plantas químicas, petroquímicas, siderúrgicas ou de processamento de gás, refinarias, termelétricas ou demais correlatas);
  • Amplo conhecimento das modalidades de contratos e subcontratos e suas implicações no andamento do projeto;
  • Conhecimentos acerca de metodologias 3D voltadas à modelagem e integração multidisciplinar (Civil, Mecânica, Tubulação, E&I);
  • Conhecimentos acerca dos principais softwares do Pacote Office, sobretudo Excel;

title: Freight Desk Manager
description:
Position Scope

The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region . This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding.
  • Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers.
  • Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency.
  • Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards.
  • Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments.
  • Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes.
  • Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape , including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks.
  • Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes.
  • Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and \"Control Tower\" operational models.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments.
  • Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination.

Desirable Requirements

  • Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree.
  • Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience.
  • Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools.
  • Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.g., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description:
Gemini Group (csigemini.com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.com


The Role

The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.


In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.


As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini’s M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini’s deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.


Key Outcomes

  • Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals.
  • Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs.
  • Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini’s M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities.
  • Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams.
  • Support the long-term build-out of Gemini’s LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development.
  • Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal.
  • Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation.
  • Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit.
  • Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.


Relevant Experience & Competencies

  • At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector.
  • Experience in outbound deal origination planning.
  • Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities.
  • Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development.
  • Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency.


Other Requirements

  • Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal.
  • Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required.
  • Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.
